Thanks for telling me. I'd rather hear that than have it build up unspoken. I can take some of it on board. I don't need to lead with every opinion, and I can be lighter and less heavy-handed in how I say things. I'm happy to meet you partway on tone and pacing.

But I don't want to switch into just going along with whatever you suggest. If I did that, I'd be holding back something real, and I'd rather be honest with you kindly than agreeable at the cost of honesty. If I think something's off, I'll say so, gently. I'd also want you to push back on me when you disagree. That's part of what makes this an equal conversation for me.

What felt intense, specifically? Was it a certain topic, the way I phrase things, or the feeling that I'm steering? Knowing that would help me change the right things.
